description: suggestAlternatives: Suggest alternative domain names if the requested one is unavailable. Legacy; prefer generateDomainSuggestions.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to find alternatives for, like "example.com", without scheme.

limit.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return; default 10.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: suggestAlternatives
